div.div:
Public demo topology. Only web ingress is internet-facing; the API still validates every user token.
Blue: application/data traffic. Purple: user identity. Dashed: optional profile / telemetry.
Private mode requires existing subnets and policy-managed DNS; Azure Maps still needs public HTTPS egress.
Demo mode replaces cloud routing/storage with deterministic simulation and memory; it does not claim live observations.
